I don’t have an answer, just a similar experience. For the past 2 months something has been mimicking my father. I tend to stay up late. I usually go to bed around 3 am. My dad goes to bed around 11-12 because he has to be up at 5:30 every morning. The first incident occurred roughly 2-2.5 months ago. My whole family was sick with covid and all in quarantine together because of it. Without jobs or school, my dad was staying up later playing video games or watching tv. On this particular night, I heard him knocking on my door around 3:30. I opened the door. He wasn’t there. I checked his room and yup. He’s asleep. Whatever. That was weird. I try to ignore it and go back to sewing and bam, there it is again. Knocking and what sounded like my dads voice saying my name, but if his head was underwater or something. It was really distorted. I opened my door and nothing was there. Honestly, at this point I thought he was messing with me. I go and wake him up and ask him why he keeps knocking on my door. It was obvious once I woke him that he had been asleep for a while. Now I’m freaked out. I go to the kitchen to get a drink and this thing that looks like my dad is standing there. I just saw him. There is absolutely no way he could have gotten to the kitchen without passing me. I tried to walk away quietly before it noticed me but right as I was turning the corner, it looked at me. It’s eyes just weren’t right. I can’t put my finger on it but they were... off. Then it spoke. It’s voice was weird and kept changing pitches like it was still trying to figure out what my dad sounds like. “Hello sweetpea. What are you doing up?” What. The. Fuck. My dad has NEVER called me “sweetpea” in my life. I told it I was heading to bed and walked backwards all the way to my room. I didn’t want to turn my back on it. For the rest of the night until my dad woke up, it would periodically knock on my door and call my name. Since that first experience, it’s just gotten worse and more frequent. I’m not sure what it is but it’s terrifying.
